text:
Liam O'Neill: Heads up team, starting AWS Marketplace AMI packaging for the private listing. Need clarity on metering (hourly vs BYOL), AMI hardening checklist, and a test-subscriber account.

Priya Mehta: Metering: AWS prefers hourly for machine images unless partner brings BYOL license. Which model are we going with?

Liam O'Neill: Proposal: hourly metered with a 30-day trial promo code. We still need entitlements config for trial users so they don't incur charges.

Carlos Vega: For private listings, we can create a usage plan that zeroes billing for subscribers with trial entitlement. Need sales to confirm trial eligibility rules.

Anne Rodriguez: Legal: put trial entitlement gating in the offer metadata and attach the trial T&Cs PDF. Also include license text for BYOL if we ever add that path.

Devon Li: AMI hardening: remove SSH keys, disable root password, turn off unused services, bake in telemetry agent with opt-out flag. Also include post-launch startup script to register the instance with our metrics host.

Priya Mehta: Can we provide a CloudFormation snippet for subscriber registration? quick example: 
```yaml
Resources:
  Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: ...
```
We should keep the snippet minimal in the listing docs.

Carlos Vega: Need a test-subscriber account from Sales to validate AMI deployment and entitlement mapping. @Sales any volunteer?

redwood-bot: Action created: [request_test_subscriber] assigned to Carlos Vega.

Anne Rodriguez: Also include data residency note in the listing: where logs/telemetry are stored and retention. Legal wants an opt-in checkbox in the UI for telemetry collection.

Liam O'Neill: Noted. We'll add telemetry opt-in and default to disabled. Also need guidance on support contact shown on the AWS listing.

Carlos Vega: Default support: partnerships@redwood.ai. If customer requests custom support contact we can add per-offer.

Priya Mehta: One more infra item: AMI needs a role that allows SSM for remote patching. Confirm minimum set of policies: AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore plus read-only S3 access for package fetch.

Devon Li: Agreed. Also recommend enabling instance-level disk encryption and documenting KMS key ARN placeholder in the packaging guide.

Liam O'Neill: Timeline: aim to have AMI + packaging docs + manifest posted to s3 by Tue EOB so we can run validation Wednesday.

Carlos Vega: I'll follow up with Sales for a test account today.

Anne Rodriguez: I'll attach the trial terms template to the partnership bucket once Carl uploads the manifest.

redwood-bot: Checklist: [AMI_hardening][CFN_snippet][Trial_terms][Telemetry_opt_in][Test_subscriber] 100% created.

Liam O'Neill: Thanks all, posting updates here. If blockers appear, call out ASAP.
